summary: Failed-start recovery retires expired or superseded restart intent instead of reviving suspended or changed agents; synthesized start controls identify the reconciler and retain the original request as evidence.

replay.detail: Pending failed-start restart requests are checked against current declaration and later lifecycle controls, including suspension and retirement, and expire after one hour. Obsolete intent is consumed without a launch or producer-closure claim.

schema.detail: No schema, migration or storage-format changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds restart-retired-obsolete-request decisions and retired restart completion status. Synthesized start control actors use agent/st3/reconciler with the original restart as evidence; requester-authored restart requests remain unchanged.

manual.detail: After a pending failed-start request expires or is superseded, an authorized new explicit restart is required to request another attempt.

recovery.detail: Retiring obsolete intent preserves unresolved producer fencing and does not manufacture closure evidence.
